text: They have some decent beers on tap. Need a little bit better organization and the girls that pour the beers need a little more education on what they are pouring. Great patio outside to relax and drink a beer Plus they grow their own hops

This was a pleasant experience for me on my quick trip to Santa Barbara. I was in the area for a sporting event and needed coffee and something quick/delicious to eat. This hit the spot and was exactly what I needed. Although it was a tad more expensive than your typical chain coffee pastries it is well worth it for a quality item. (I don't tend to enjoy or purchase many pastries at starbucks, coffee bean, etc..) at 7:30am there were many customers already waiting/eating. They offered to heat up my bacon egg brioche bun item and it was perfect. If I'm ever in the area again their breakfast sandwich would be my next purchase!

This place is great!!! I recently moved to the area and tried their coffee. I was pleasantly surprised by how great their coffee tastes. I really enjoyed my latte and the also have really yummy pastries. The almond croissant is one of my favorites. The place is not loud like other coffee shops and they offer free WiFi for customers. I will definitely be coming back!

I LOVE this bakery! It is the closest I have come to the real deal in Paris! I love their almond croissants, chocolate croissants, and the puffy muffin thingys (probably should be named muffin top, but TOTALLY worth it haha) that I swear are pure, delicious butter. The staff is always courteous, fast service, and the atmosphere is buzzing with excitement. You see people from all walks of life (older couples, people rockin' their pajamas, business types) just hang out and scarf on yummy pastries. They also have great coffee and espresso, I really enjoyed my soy vanilla latte last time I was there.
Overall this is a great place and will be heading back soon for another pastry fix.

I only tried 2 things but they were both delicious. 

The chicken korma was delicious. I wish I had gotten mild as I forget medium in Indian food is really hot. 

The curry fries are out of this world!!!!  Run, don't walk and go get them now!

They are waffle fries with some kind of cheese and curry sauce on them. Super delicious.

I hope this restaurant succeeds. It's really good food. Probably the best Indian in town.

The workers stared at me and my friends while we were studying and kept wandering around where we were, which was very uncomfortable. Then they "politely" (it was in the most condescending, rude tone) told a group of 4 of us that we had to leave because not all of us ordered drinks and I said I'll buy a drink because I genuinely wanted one and the rude lady goes "I don't want to make you do something you don't want to do, so you can leave". They were very disingenuous.  
There was a much better way to handle the situation than make your customers uncomfortable.
Love this place, the vibe, location and most of all the coffee. My favorite is their signature State Street Blend. I drink it black. No cream, no sugar.

I like the sandwiches a lot, but I do wish they used better bread.  Yeah, I have high standards for bread, but still.  The coffee is so-so (tends to run a little weak by my tastes), and the past couple of times I've been there, the lady taking orders seems quite bored to be taking my order.  At any rate, I still go there when I'm hungry in the neighborhood, but wouldn't go out of my way.

We got a cake for a baby shower and all the ladies were very impressed with the raspberry Bavarian cream cake. It was very moist and delicious. Bakery Staff were very amenable and easy to work with. We brought Olive leaves to decorate and they beautifully decorated the cake. Would buy any cake here again.

Probably ok if you are gluten intolerant, otherwise it's about average coffee with tasteless baked goods (coffee cake) that have the typical "sandy" gluten free texture (apple pie). Decent presentation and good service. Overpriced. Go elsewhere if you're not gluten intolerant.

I'm a cupcake snob, so I'm always a little nervous trying out new cupcake places (not that I can resist of course ;) I've been disappointed before. 

But the cupcakes here were FANTASTIC - on par w/ my all-time favorites Sprinkles (Beverly Hills) and Sticky Fingers (DC). I tried all of the flavors they offered that day! Every single one was delicious. 

From your tried-and-true basics like strawberry and chocolate to red velvet and the "margarita" special flavor - every one was a winner. I tried about 5 different flavors in mini-size and then had one in regular size - I think it was called the cinnamon coffee cake. DELICIOUS. It had a gooey cinnamon center and yummy frosting - just so good.

All of the cakes were perfectly moist and flavorful and the icing was just the way I like it - light and sugary, not heavy and buttery.

ALSO - I had breakfast in their cafe and really loved it. Probably had the best chai latte I've ever had (so sad to have to go back to Peet's now, since I was just visiting Santa Barbara for a few days). I loved the house-made granola w/ fruit and granola - simple and nourishing.

Next time I visit Santa Barbara, I will not leave w/out a visit to Crushcakes! :)

Both times I've been here I've been disappointed.

I walked down for the Kickin' Cowboy salad. Left with my salad only to discover it was missing the avocado and jalapenos. Super sad. Especially for the price. South Coast has better salads for less in my opinion.

Definitely not a locals place over the weekend...but during the week it's a magnificent place to get quality breakfast for locals.  High priced breakfast, but you can't put a price on quality. Poached eggs are made to perfection, the pancetta crisp and flavorful. The breads are the best in town. Try the multigrain sourdough or the seeded bagged. Service during the week is good. Pass on the Coffee go to   Handlebar Coffee Roasters

Heather saved our day! I called her with 3 hours to spare and she baked up the most perfect vanilla cake. The florals were the perfect touch. Can't wait to give it to our birthday girl tonight. Thank you heather!
Best Starbucks on State St. They are always busy but are fast and the quality is always good. Staff is very friendly as well.

This place is not only yummy, healthy amazing food! But the owner Rebecca is exceptional. She has so much knowledge and even in the midst of busyness will take the time to suggest new items! Such a gem in Santa Barbara!

Food is generally good. The GM or main manager is awesome. Half the staff is friendly, the other half not so much. Recently the prices were upped & I think $18 for a medium sized sandwich & a small green salad or just medium salad is a little but crazy.

I was so happy when this location opened up. Now, no trip through or to Santa Barbara is complete with out a stop here.
The coffee is perfect and the service here is great.

I ordered the Caesar Salad. It was room temperature and the croutons were soggy. The water was straight out of the tap, which is ok, but no ice is offered, so it was room temperature as well. Just sub-par at best all the way around. My wife enjoyed her Eggs Benedict. I expected a more vegan-friendly menu for a Santa Barbara eatery, but no luck. If you're vegan, look elsewhere.

I love their Island Bowl so much! Had a chance to enjoy a bowl while on a weekend getaway & since I've been back home, I can't stop thinking about it. Lol will definitely visit again when I'm in town or in LA (because I've already looked up all the locations lol)
Great and inviting interior, good tasting java, lots of seating, free wi-Fi. What more could you ask for except someone to share a spot like this with?

Amazing food! 
I got the chicken marsala with brown rice and it was delicious! The ambiance is great and the employees are extremely friendly.  I loved that they had a salad bar and a wide selection of drinks that you can choose from. 
Try some of their housemade desserts as well! 

Highly recommend the Savoy Cafe :)
Simply the best coffee. Homegrown, family run, beans roasted in-house & onsite. I love the place, and I recommend it to my friends who come to town for an original SB experience.

One of my favorite SB spots. Very unassuming with an awesome lunch and late night menu. 

I've tried the fried rice with tri-tip (wonderful)., the crab melt--the house made English muffin bread is so soft and good. I've also had the bahn-mi, which was one of the best things I've ever tasted. The baguette was PERFECT with a chewy soft interior and crisp exterior. The roast beef was so fresh and awesome and whatever aioli they put on it was simply amazing. I want to try everything on the menu, so I'm going to keep coming back. They also have creative house made teas (and sodas?). I tried the grapefruit green tea one day and it was incredible.

Went here today for crummy service. Bit into a sandwich and had yolk explode all over my clothes. The waitress apologized but then didn't even clean the yolk covered table. I didn't pay 30 bucks for coffee and some sandwiches to have everything be a mess. Who makes a yolk over easy on a sandwich?! Bathrooms were disgusting!!! Go somewhere else! Poor service.

What a great little coffee shop and so much more. They sell teas and spices as well as gifts. I almost bought a wallet here haha. It was a nice wallet. Kind of wish I did buy it now actually. 

I tried one of the Hawaiian coffees that is only around for few months out of the year. It was the best coffee I've had in a long time. And I'm a connoisseur. I was really impressed by the large selection of coffees that they offered. I ended up buying new different teas from them that have all turned out to be fabulous.

I really wish I had a place like this in my hometown. It would be my go to for sure. Oh and by the way the girl at the cash register was as sweet as could be. No Starbucks attitude here.

Ah mazing food and the nicest owners! Our first time here and it was worth the drive from Thousand Oaks! Might have to make it our once a month brunch place now! The croq Monsieur was sooo soft and delish! The quality of their food is top notch and you can tell it's made AND served with pride! Highly recommend!

On another note: to all the people nit picking on the price, obviously have never owned a business like this to appreciate the overhead costs for high quality ingredients AND time that it takes to hand make everything from scratch! I bake for fun at home and just have to say it takes HOURS to proof and re kneed sometimes two or three times to get bread specially brioche fluffy and delicate! TIME IS MONEY! These sweet people are hand making everything from scratch and that alone should be appreciated! So for the small handful of people that oh so casually throw negative reviews so easily "maybe it IS best you go and get your bread from a cheaper place. You obviously don't have the palate nor the appreciation for small family run business with high quality ingredients served with the kind and sincere heart as these owners!"

And no I am not paid to write this, nor am I a personal friend OR a family member!

I ordered 100 whoopee pies in assorted flavors for my wedding favors. They came very fresh, delicious and adorably packaged, and guests gave them tons of compliments. The strawberry/butter cake combo was to die for!
Simply the best breads and coffee I've had since we came to the US and all home made. Lovely French owners, we'll be back tomorrow.

A very different kind of coffee shop, but I like it. They take your average latte above and beyond with coffee mixology. We got the Burnout and the Maillard's Folly. The Burnout is served in a coupe glass with a delicious ginger salt rim with a blackberry garnish. All the flavors blended well except for the blackberry. The Maillard's Folly on the other hand was delicious from drink to garnish. Felt like a drink you'd have by the pool on vacation. Their presentation is flawless. The aesthetic of the cafe is beautiful and relaxing. A place I'd love to come on the regular to relax and have a nice drink. I appreciate their attention to conservation and high quality ingredients. Great cafe to visit!
Typical diner style food.  Great potatoes and has browns.  Lots of cool history and great atmosphere.

Our hotel (Montecito Inn) recommended Jeannine's as a good place to go for breakfast, and I'm so glad they did. 

The menu had tons of delicious options, and our meals were amazing. I ordered the special, a turkey sausage, spinach breakfast burrito, which came with a choice of potatoes or fruit salad and a spicy sauce. My friends also loved their pancakes, bacon, and brunch item featuring eggs, Kale, and chili sauce. 

The restaurant is small-ish, but also has a patio to dine outside. It's one of those places where you order your meal at the register and they bring out your food once you've chosen a spot. 

Such a little gem in Santa Barbara!

I reserved Pure Order for an event, and it was incredible. 

They were so helpful in setting up the event, let us drop stuff off the night before. The staff at the event were incredible, helping people with beer choices and everything. Just about everyone at the event commented on how friendly they were. 

The beer itself was great. Lots of variety, with it all being nice easy drinking beer. The guests had an overwhelmingly positive things to say. 

The space is incredible, and might be the highpoint. For an event, it is out of this world. The out door games are great, the sitting area is relaxed and comfortable, and the entire place just gets better at night when the lights come on. 

I would definitely recommend this brewery for a relaxed beer and a lawn game, but it should be the first place you consider if you need an event space in SB.

Woo! 500th Review!

Simply Divine! :)

This place is on a one way street... which is odd...and requires circling this place like a hawk... but it's worth it. I promise you!

We were lucky enough to find parking right in front... which was great... since Santa Barbara is way too congested! 

I loved the outside of the building to begin with... old architecture... adorable!

The inside was quaint. A little display case with some cute cupcakes in the case. I didn't see the added "cuteness" people were talking about in the other reviews... so I don't know.

I am SO glad that Pumpkie brought this place up!! So so glad! Plus, I got a cute added laugh at his comment about me looking at cupcake pictures as if I were looking at a cute puppy. Adorable.

The goods:

I had the Strawberry Cupcake...and it was heavenly! Probably the best strawberry cupcake that I've ever tasted. The "strawberry cake" part was moist and tasty... but not too sweet. The buttercream frosting on top was like an amazingly tasty strawberry ice cream... I really don't know how they infused the flavor of real strawberries in this light icing... but they definitely succeeded. It really was amazingly tasty and there was the perfect frosting to cake ratio. Yum!

We also shared a vanilla iced with chocolate cake. It was yummy. Vanilla-y and the cake bottom was moist and definitely very chocolatey. It was delicious too!

Pumpkie had a peanut butter chocolate one which he said was good...and now I can't remember the other one he had... oh no!

Oh yeah! The tie-dye cupcake. It was vanilla but the frosting was "tie-dyed" with different swirls. There was a chocolate disc "peace sign" on top of a yellow cake with sprinkles baked into it. He said it was good. I don't know. Didn't taste it... but it looked really awesome! :)

The cupcakes were amazingly tasty! Definitely check this place out if you're in the area... they're definitely one of the better cupcake places out there!

This place was just "ok". Maybe I was expecting more from a brunch place with such high reviews. I had the Tugboat with salmon, and my friend had the Sweet Maria sandwich.
First of all, the food took a VERY long time to come out. The food itself was just "ok". I enjoyed the Tugboat, but it was just an embellished eggs benedict, which didnt taste like anything that special. The sandwich was very underwhelming. There was almost no seasoning on the chicken, and there wasnt enough sauce. She had to add hot sauce to add some flavor, which she never does. In addition, the chips that the sandwich came with were very bland and unseasoned. For the price that you have to pay (around $30) for two people without beverages for an uncomfortable seating area, I expected more from the food.

I think the only reason why this place is popular is because this place is dog friendly. The dogs take up a lot of extra space that could be used for human customers since the seating space is very limited.
Great food! Fresh and delicious. We had the quesadilla appetizer and the chicken tacos. Split them both and left feeling satisfied. Would definitely recommend!

Food was ok I guess. A little bit on the pricier side for what I got.
Good service though, our waiter was really nice

Despite having a couple of Spudnuts between me and this location, this is definitely the one to visit.  Everyone working here is really nice and welcoming, and the donuts are very fresh.  There are also a lot of places to sit and relax while you have your donuts.  The coffee is traditional donut shop coffee, and I'm glad I can go somewhere to get some hazelnut coffee.

I went here on the recommendation of my friend.  Thankfully, I was able to visit a couple of times before my friend moved out of town.  I'm definitely coming back here the next time I want some donuts in my life.

Got a free pizza coupon in the mail and decided to give it a try....YUM! We got the three pepper with feta and pickled onions and it was absolutely delicious. Unique topping combos - Will definitely be returning to try the other pizzas. Thanks!
Not slot to say except if you love bagels you will love jacks! And if you don't know jacks than you are missing out on the best bagels on the central coast!

Lets talk about the price of cupcakes... at $3 for a "regular size" cupcake is pricey... but that's life in the world of designer cupcakes.  So, that being said, even though I did mark pricey I think it's the norm for this product.

My friend & I think that Crushcakes are well worth the $3/cupcake, in fact we thought they were worth twice the price!  In fact, if we were driving by Santa Barbara, not going to Santa Barbara, we'd go out of our way to stop here & get our fix for the road!  ;)

We had the Strawberry Blush (fresh strawberry cake (pureed berries in the batter!) topped w/ rosy pink strawberry frosting) & Lemon Drop (luscious lemon cake w/ sweet lemon frosting & fresh lemon zest).  These cupcakes are moist!  The name of each cupcake is suitable - the flavors are apparent in both the cake and the frosting.  These cupcakes are well-balanced.  These cupcakes are not all about the frosting as so many are (boo-hiss!).   

Bonus points for their eco-friendly ways & environmental awareness.

Food is not extraordinary for their prices. We came for breakfast and got corned beef hash (small portion of meet) and a big pile of country potatoes without any seasoning. That is the most expensive item in the breakfast menu. My hubby got the breakfast sandwich, the egg was soft in the sandwich and it created a mess all over. They serve it in toasted hard bread. If you care for your teeth, stay away from that one. 
We also got an over controlling waitress that felt the need to make remarks on our every move: "I guess your husband went to the bathroom"....: / she was just out of it. Very uncomfortable to seat with active little kids and pay attention to a waitress that was obviously over involved.

Savoy is perfect for any meal of the day. Their gf meal and treat options are very enjoyable. We have eaten there many times and have not had a single thing we disliked. We feel great after eating here. No heavy after feeling, and no food guilt. The location is easily accessible. The cafe is clean and airy. We definitely recommend Savoy!
Friendly staff and spacious outside seating. One of the best huevos rancheros I have ever had. Excellent latte's. We will definitely be returning!
Jeanine's has been a regular brunch place for me and my friends. We tried eggs Benedict, French toast, coffee, crossiant and cakes. Everything is tasteful.

First of all, the waiter we had was EXCELLENT and your bartender made a Long Island (01/27/2015 dinner time) better than any I have had in this town! Not upscale I know, but heck, it is the real deal!!! Both a 5-star!!! He was so kind and helpful

Your food off the American menu is okay, not amazing. Your Kong Xin Cai 空心心脏蔬菜 off the Chinese menu (which is printed in English) was good--a little too much salt with the garlic sauce but the flavor was good. The Chinese-style chicken and taro hot pot was delicious and the Capitol Ribs were excellent! The beef with asparagus was okay and the asparagus though tender was huge chunks (I would have opted for the more delicate thinner stalks but imagine its what is available at the time of this writing).

The jasmine tea 茉莉花茶 was just okay as the water tasted like tap water that steeped it. I think the place is dirty! The dirty almost oxidized drapes, tattered booths, Christmas lights wrapping the windows that are falling down, paint that is peeling with food on the window ledges/sills and dusty kimono, and horrible water feature and fake plants needs a much needed revision to justify your prices.  That is my reason for a 3-star, though arguably this could be a 4-Star dive after the second Long Island. I wish you could add to your menu, soup filled pork-dumplings like they have in NYC (lower East side) and Taiwan, but I know it takes mastery to pull those off.

Looking forward in returning and possibly upgrading my rating a star or two.
I have been here a few times but never made it for breakfast. Delicious and highly recommended. Met the owner Gillian and she is very awesome. So glad that this delicious place is doing so well!!

This place is a slightly better version of Starbucks. I paid $2.75 for a small Americano. $2.95 for a small cappuccino. I dunno, I wasn't impressed, but it wasn't shitty either.

Oh, one more thing, lot's of hot white girls hang here. So fellas, bring your cute dogs when you come here.

Had lunch here for the first time. Our fries were cold and my salad was okay. The burger and the bacon was great! Might try something else next time.... the place has a great atmosphere and it was really nice inside. Staff was also friendly and helpful.

Most underrated spot in the Funk Zone! For all those people waiting in line at Finney's and Santo Mezcal the Goat Tree has better food and tables readily available.

Food - This place is very unassuming, so we were pleasantly surprised how good the food was. The Faroe Island Salmon was so flavorful, everything on the dish worked well together. The Wild Arugula Salad was good but the chicken add-on stole the show. It was perfectly seasoned and very juicy.

Service - A relaxed atmosphere (maybe too relaxed). The service is admittedly slow and they seem to be understaffed. That being said you're in SB a couple blocks from the beach so it's not too much of a burden to wait a little while.

Ambience - It was one of the hotter days in SB yesterday but the canopy of palm trees provided plenty of relief. This is one of the best outdoor dining setups in the Funk Zone. It's in a prime location on State Street and very aesthetically pleasing.

I like the feel of a coffee shop that makes the community come together. While we were here we heard people strike up conversations and strangers meeting strangers. It was nice and cozy too. There isn't much seating inside and limited seating on the sidewalk but you'll get a good feeling coming here.

The baristas were great and helped us through our large order. Very cool people.

My husband and I have been cappuccino hunting throughout Goleta/Santa Barbara county for awhile and after trying all the givens, we have found ourselves returning most consistently to Goleta Coffee co. Not only are their cappuccinos the most consistent, but their sandwiches are also amazing! Always well staffed with solid baristas and the coziest atmosphere in town, you won't regret stopping by Goleta Coffee co.

Showed up with my family 10 mins prior to closing time and was met with a "Sorry, we're closed" sign. When I walked in to ask why the store was closed before business hours, I was told by one of the associates that they had other orders to fill and usually closed early to do so. I find this to be unacceptable and it was a negative way to end my family's day trip to Santa Barbara. I would really appreciate an explanation! As would the others that were hoping to get a cool smoothie on this hot day.

I love this place!!! I try to eat pretty healthy and cook my own meals but if I'm too lazy I will go here. The food is fresh, perfectly seasoned, and good for ya!  My favorite thing is the Mediterranean salad which is piled high with eggplant, hummus, pita bread and good stuff.  The cozy cafe has been in Santa Barbara for a long time and I hope it stays that way!! Locals like myself depend on it!  Also the soups are always tasty and the chicken stir fry is my go to.

The best almond croissant you can get in Santa Barbara. If you find anything better here, please let me know. the croissant is big and a lot of fillings and almond toppings. 
They also have a lot of pastries to choose from, some of them are very pretty. good as a gift.

Amazing salads for amazing prices. We all loved the food and great service. This place is very casual with self service but the food is worth a visit. We went there twice weithin a day. First for coffee and cookies and later for dinner. We can recommend the Ranch chicken salad and the arugula salmon salad. Everything else looked very good as well.

From Love to feeling a bit bummed you dropped the Ham & Cheese a la carte croissant.  Why? For those of us who cant eat a lot of egg (my family), now we just cant come here for breakfast like we used to..a lot!  You still have good croissants and we lived in France so are particular.  We didnt see our favorite apricot croissants..please say you didn't remove those ?!?  Visitors note - with their new locations they have now a new smaller menu...

I'm not even sure I can handle how delicious this food is. I did the build your own has, and it was amazing. Sweet potato, corned beef, corn, mushrooms and spinach with a side of salsa? It was amazing, literally one of the best hashes I've had in my life. Also, they ask you if you want jam or butter with your toast, but what they fail to tell you is they make their own jam! It's strawberry jam with chunks of strawberry in it, and it's really really good. So pop in, order some food at the counter, grab your emoji holder and eat out on the patio. A wonderful little spot for a delicious breakfast.

I'm gonna give them 4 stars just based on the fact that this is one of the better places in SB that I have experienced.  

They are super accommodating to special dietary needs and the dim sum on the weekends is actually edible! 

Oh, and the family that owns it is from Taiwan!  ah... so that's why the food is good!  ;) 

This and the chinese place on the Mesa, so far, so good...

AWFUL AWFUL AWFUL DISGUSTING! They didn't even know what a flat white was! The girl was just clueless and the cup she served the "coffee" in was leaking! 
Coffee tasted burnt and sour! 
As a barista she needs to know how to make coffee and not ask the customer how it's made. It's like going to a cocktail bar and the person behind the bar asks you how to make your cocktail!! 
My boyfriend and I trashed that coffee she made us, it was not drinkable!
Note to management: employ competent people who can provide excellent service and know their job!
Great breakfast food. I usually get their New Orleans omelette with avocado but have tried other stuff and I've never been disappointed.

Yoga Soup is amazing. When I moved to Santa Barbara I was recovering from surgery due to a running injury. Heather's Active Beginners class was a great way to regain strength and flexibility, and challenge myself safely. She was very attentive to modifying poses. For anyone looking for an introduction to yoga, Heather's class is a undoubtedly the place to start. Eddie's classes are so therapeutic and fun. The classes are crowded, but for a reason! I love when he blasts the music and we just dance/move around/let loose. I'm not that great at Yoga, but all classes I've been to at Yoga Soup truly are a safe space to explore and practice.

Always enjoyable and relaxing. I love to people watch and this is definitely a place where you can do that. The other great thing about the grind is the staff and the fact that it's mostly locals and not tourists.

I went there to buy lose leaf tea. I am trying to refill what I can instead of buying things in packages to eliminate waste.  The selection of tea is very good and I found that the quality was the best I have had in a long time. I bought the Irish breakfast and enjoyed the smooth taste, no bitterness at all. What a difference loose leaf tea is compared to packaged stale tea bags! I paid $2.40/oz. I will also be coming here to refill my spices. They have almost every spice you need in the kitchen. The atmosphere was quaint and peaceful. I enjoyed my tea while playing a game of dominos.  I was also happy to support a local business, they seem to be disappearing everywhere. Support local businesses please.

This is a review of the drinks only. 

The place has that familiar old-school diner smell...cigarettes and ketchup even though no one was smoking inside.

Went here twice during my trip to SB. We had heard about the reputation of this place for serving strong drinks. They did not disappoint! 

First time was on a Thursday night at around 10pm. Not crowded, but not dead either. I was still not in the mood to drink after foolishly capping off my afternoon of beer drinking with a $4 Grey Goose and Redbull at The Neighborhood. I couldn't resist the price! 

Anyway...my girlfriend ended up getting a Vodka Cran at Joe's. More like a vodka-cran martini with ice! Took her FOREVER to finish it! I was really tempted to get a Hendricks and tonic, but figured it would be a bad idea considering how I was feeling. Bartender was really friendly and chit-chatted with us...and also made sure my glass of WATER was full. 

Went back here on Friday night around the same time. Place was PACKED with people I assume were getting their pre-party drink on. Everyone seemed to at least be in their mid-late 20's. About an even mix of normal folks and d-bags(shades at night, too much cologne, etc). Had to wait awhile to get my drink, but the bartender took care of my order despite the dbag next to me who was waving his $100 bill in the bartender's face.  

Got a Hendricks and tonic. Wow, it was strong. If I was at any other place, I'd ask the bartender if he forgot the tonic.

If haven't been here yet YOURE MISSING OUT. Ask for Olivia she's the best !! Santa Barbara Benedict is my favorite. a nice little quiet spot right on de le Vina . But don't be fooled this place gets packed for breakfast . I've been here several times and it's always amazing!

I found this cute hidden spot through Yelp and am so glad I did! We sat outside and enjoyed the beautiful Santa Barbara sunshine. We ordered their fig cream cheese french toast, the pesto mushroom omelette, fried chicken and biscuits, and the chilaquiles. Every food item that we ordered was delicious and huge portions! The fig cream cheese french toast was amazing. I would recommend sharing it because it is so sweet and rich in flavor and a few bites is plenty. All of the food came out hot and fresh. Everything was well prepared and flavorful. They also have a great mimosa/bottom less brunch. Our experience here was excellent and we recommend it!

This review is purely based on the customer service I've received multiple times through phone calls- I haven't had a chance to go into the shop, I was originally really really looking forward to checking out this coffee shop but after speaking with who ever was working I don't even want to go anymore. 
The most recent time I spoke with two different people to just get pricing on coffee airpots/travelers for a meeting. We really like to support local businesses. The woman who was helping me was rude to me over the simple question on if they offer coffee airpots and did not know how many servings were in it. I wish I received a more pleasant person to speak with when asking a question but both women were not. 

I hope to give this place another chance and hopefully receive better service in person- but I don't plan on going any time soon.

This place seems to be packed but to me, kind of awkward. Free internet with purchase is nice, and is honestly the only reason I would go here over Starbucks. Also about $.80 cheaper for what I generally order, which is definitely a plus.

At most places the Iced Coffee is brewed a bit stronger (since it is destined to be poured over ice, and henceforth becomes diluted) but not at Peets. The iced coffee here is pretty watery to start with and putting the same amount of cream as I would at other places made it overly smooth and easy to drink quickly (not a plus in my book, I like it rough). So what you ask, you get the buzz faster, right? Nope, it never came! 

Not bad, but not good. Better places for coffee in SB for sure, try SB Roasting Company (or anything less chain-like for that matter.)

Our family had the build your own hash, veggie omelette and the gluten free pancakes.  Maybe I have lived a sheltered life, but this was one of the best breakfasts we have ever had.  The people and service were really cool too

My husband and I recently spent the weekend in SB and I was in need of a caffeine boost.  We saw the Starbucks, but I wanted something local.  After searching Yelp, I was sold on this place because of the mention of vegan cinnamon rolls.  I got the vanilla one and it was delicious.  If I knew how good it would be I would have purchased the whole tray.

I also ordered an iced latte with soy and a triple espresso (because of the buy 1/get 1 deal). I was impressed by the quality of the espresso.  It was perfectly roasted and smooth, without a bitter taste.  I just had to add a touch of honey to the iced latte and it was perfect.  I saved the triple espresso for the next day and even after sitting a refrigerator overnight and being reheated in the microwave, it still tasted good.

In addition to the vegan cinnamon rolls and espresso, I have to give some love to the people working there.  They are so energetic and nice!

Love the feel and the setting of this place, has a sweet European feel to it. Their "HAB double cheese Burger" is to die for. I think one of the best in town. The mustard aioli and the melty cheese will have your tastebuds asking for more. Great place to go catch up with friend or dine solo.
Very popular place and for a good reason. Yum. They must be listening to the complaints about service as they were quite attentive.   Highly recommended

Why did I not know about this place when I attended UCSB?!?! Thanks to yelp I've had the opportunity to discover this quaint cafe.  The cafe is a bit small but it gives out a nice homey feeling.

Everybody's been raving about their almond croissants but just to my dismay they ran out...I guess they're that popular and good! So, I opted for their chocolate croissant..but was rather disappointed. The croissant was stale and not fresh.  Besides the croissant...their beef sandwich and cheese ravioli was rich in flavor. The Caramel/Sea Salt macarons was also amazing! Just thinking about their food is making me want to drive up to Santa Barbara.~
Nice brunch place to sit outside when the weather is nice. Favorites: The tugboat, Sando, and YOLO. Pair it with a chai latte. Nice!

Seriously the best coffee ever!!! Super cool atmosphere, the staff are friendly and passionate about what they serve. My coffee came with a flaming marshmallow!! The detail they put into each coffee is fantastic

I love their bread and sweets and no doubt that bakery has really good quality products. If you are coffee drinker, I'm matcha drinker. I had the worst  match today. For a small cup of matcha latte. I paid $5.98 plus tip. It was a cup full of milk with a faded color of matcha. After the first sip went straight to trash can. It was a cup of m

My wife and I both ordered huevos ranchos--beautiful presentation and delicious--my wife said best huevos ranchos she ever had. I wouldn't quite go that that far but I would say excellent, especially for a place that doesn't specialize in mexican food.

Had a wonderful lunch here. Ordered the tomato and fresh mozz Panini with greens which was very tasty and fresh. Wonderful glass of pinot noir. Great service. Wonderful patio ambiance. Felt like a European café. The server was attentive and quick and our order came out quickly. Wonderful experience. Only reason not giving 5 stars is because the pour size of the wine was pretty skimpy.

The line in this store is in an interesting spot. No big deal, I just thought it was awkward. the first thing I noticed was the lobby, it was huge. I've never seen so many tables and seats in a Starbucks. I like it!
I ordered my drink as a barista stocked the cold case. I remember saying, "excuse me" when I was loading the case and needed to get by customers but that was lost here. The barista who took my order was friendly and nice, as was the one who made my drink.

I just had breakfast at the State Street Denny's. We live a few blocks away and never go to Denny's. We had great service and the food was surprisingly good. My wife mentioned that we should come in more often.

We had a coupon, and when we paid, we were told it had expired and the manager wouldn't accept it. I've managed several top Santa Barbara restaurant's in the past, and if a coupon brought in a customer we would happily accept it, no matter the expiration. This manager could have told us their policy, and accepted the coupon "this time" and we would have been happy with our experience. 

As it was, it ruined an otherwise pleasant morning, and I'll make a point of never going back to this Denny's!

To whom this may concern. 
Wow. Hiring young woman must be difficult. The young lady that just helped us was so caught up talking to her two male friends. Didn't even acknowledge my wife and I standing there for 5 minutes. I had to stand right next to her friends to get any kind of service. When I asked her for a six pack of cupcakes she had pre-made sets. I asked if I could pick my own since my wife and I wanted to same flavor a but didn't want to share. The young lady stated that we only have six flavors and that was it. Ok what does that have to do with picking my own flavors?  When we finally were on the same page and we had chosen our selection of cup cakes, the young lady had the nerve in grabbing all the cup cakes with her bare hands with no means of protection. My wife was the one who noticed that and said it after we left the location. 

It's up to you if you decide to eat there but the service for just a simple cupcake was terrible. I'm going to crush cakes now. Where the service is fantastic.

The Little Things Bakery made the most beautiful and delicious wedding cake for our wedding. We love lemon cake and were thrilled to see that as an option. They were accommodating and helpful during the ordering process. We settled on half lemon and half chocolate for a three tier cake and a sheet cake for 150 people. They were also the most affordable in the area. The cake tasting was great and the fee was even applied towards the final bill. They worked well with my other vendors as they had to deliver to The Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront resort and our florist Besame Florals.

Hello land of white people. I haven't been to a place without ethnicity in a while. I guess this place proved that you can stay in business with a loyal clientele. The menu is standard and unimaginative. The service was decent but not sure why a full sandwich needed an extra 10 minutes to cook when all the half sandwiches came out within 5 minutes of ordering. There is nothing wrong with this place but nothing great about it  almost like you want to eat your food in the fridge but don't feel like it. It's food that tastes better because other people made it.

The museum cafe is a great place to have a nice lunch. Good atmosphere and delicious food. One of the owners Emily makes great mimosas which are great for a Sunday brunch which we have started doing. I would highly recommend the 5 cheese panini, but make sure to add chicken and a side of aioli sauce, sooooooo good. They recently added lamb shank which is also very good. They also serve very good desserts which is usually always different, the lemon cake and carrot cake with cream cheese frosting is to die for. The museum cafe is one of those places you just need to check out for yourself, the food and service will speak for itself.

This is a really nice cafe to go to at night. The trees are wrapped in lights and the plants are well lit all around. Good vibe for late night coffee,
I ordered a simple vanilla latte with a slice of lemon meringue and it was delicious. Latte was smooth not too sweet and the pie was perfect not too tart and the meringue was in small little dots all over, even ratio of meringue to filling. They also brought me water in a carafe, that was a really nice touch. Just perfect overall feel.
Good spot by the beach, good tasting drinks and good food. You can't ask for more when you can put your feet in the sand and enjoy a cold beer.

Four of us came and dined for dinner on the patio.  Food and service were stellar.  A hidden gem!
Starters:  Clam chowder.  Very good with plenty of clams.
                Calamari.  Generous portion.  Light and delicious. 
Mains:     Pork chop...oh so delicious w/brussel sprouts.
                Steak/frites...just the way he likes it!!
                Short ribs w/polenta....fall off the fork tender.
                 Ahi tuna special...out of this world.
We encourage you to patronize this lovely restaurant.  We certainly will!

Alessia has done an outstanding job with this patisserie. It is the warmest environment with the friendliest staff. I really feel like I'm back at Cafe Angelina in Paris!! I had a vanilla latte paired with a croissant before breakfast and it was the flakiest I've ever had. I've been back for a few more since! This day, I enjoyed breakfast with a friend who ordered the Croqué Monsieur- he was done in 5 minutes, I swear! I ordered the Two Eggs for a good protein to start my day and the bacon was perfect! We then shared the Blintz and stuffed ourselves to the brim! Overall, our experience was divine and we will DEFINITELY be back.

The food is excellent here and I would come here much more often if the staff were not so unfriendly.  The girl that helped me today did not smile, say hi, and just stared at me blankly.  She did not give me my receipt and when I asked what was in the sample, she didn't know.  Love the food but the staff really needs to practice better customer service.  Just smiling would be nice.
Do not leave without trying the almond croissant and the exotic cake. BTW calling exotic a cake might be an insult. Much better than a cake.
While passing through Santa Barbara we stopped in here for a weekday breakfast.  It's fast and excellent - far better than any of the cookie cutter places we passed on the way here.  Recommended.
We really enjoyed our first time here.   The sandwiches were very fresh, and used first class ingredients.   I would definitely recommend.

Their bahn mi is my favorite late night treat to myself on the weekends, whether I'm getting off work at midnight or need a bite while going out with friends. The staff is good humored and sweet with fast delivery time and that sandwich is AMAZING. Thank you Blue Owl!!!!!!

It's been a little over 48 hours and I STILL can't get this deliciousness out of my head. If you're looking for a tasty breakfast spot with a chill vibe, this is the place. We ordered the Chilaquiles and the Tugboat and shared the two. You can't go wrong with either. We added salmon on our Tugboat and I'm drooling over the memory of this dish. I may want to try the Tugboat with the fried chicken next time but the salmon was delightful. I need to stop with this review and grab some lunch before I completely drool all over myself. Check this place out!
This is a great place. I thought I was in France. Sitting on the front patio, we were seated by French speaking guest. The food is fabulous, and the staff friendly. I could eat here every day.

This is one if not one of the best Starbucks that I go to. They know you by name if you are a regular and just overall friendly staff. They take the time to make sure that your order is right and are overall satisfied. They are prompt and precise and can tell that they have fun and enjoy what they do!

GREAT FOOD, GREAT SERVICE, and GREAT COURTYARD TO RELAX AND PEOPLE WATCH

I was actually surprised when initially I saw 3 stars. I decided to try it for myself and my hubby since the place looks so inviting. We ordered the PROTEIN FRITTATA. It has cracked eggs, hearts of palm, sweet piquillo peppers, foraged mushrooms, and aged cheddar.  It was delicious and satisfying! And I'm always a sucker for mushrooms. We also got the SMOKED SALMON TOAST. It has everything cream cheese, tomatoes, onions, capers, tomatoes on sourdough. Both delicious and filling to fuel up our Urban Wine Walk in the Funk Zone. 

And their latte was soooo fresh, tasty, and well balanced!! I never had to put sugar and it wasn't lukewarm. Two signs of a great cup of java! 
 
We also got a hazelnut-chocolate dessert from their bakery and it was delicious and decadent! 

Service was wonderful! Wait was probably 10 minutes to get a table. Since the waitstaff checked in on us consistently I rarely had to flag them down. 

Definitely try it here for a nice brunch experience!

Honestly, the best english muffin and jam I've ever had. Ever. Coffee was repeatedly filled the entire time. The food was...decent (bf got the wet burrito...looked hella spicy; and I got something like a Monterey scramble?). Nothing I'll crave besides that ENGLISH MUFFIN. Service was perfect. Great little breakfast spot, in a great location.
I had some bread from here - how was it so good? The hygge bun was amazing. How can bread be so good? I don't get it.

Came in on New Year's Day, and were highly, highly disappointed.  They were "swamped" (although it didn't seem overly crowded), and when I got up to (politely) let them know that we had been sitting at our table for 15 minutes without even a glance in our direction, I was told that I would "just have to be patient."

We were discouraged by our server from ordering an appetizer because they were "so busy."  Instead, we were promised bread and butter and had to ask again for it 3 times before it ever came out, after our meals had finally arrived.
The water they served had a funny, tap-watery taste to it.
I ordered the Chicken Cobb salad; wimpy and served with completely burnt and inedible bacon.
My husband ordered the Chicken chili and said it tasted canned, bland, and the chicken was tough.
He also had a grilled chicken sandwich which he said was "terrible."

Thankfully we had a coupon so we didn't pay full price!  
 
Terrible service, terrible food.  Really disappointed.  Never coming back.

Hearing so much about this place we decided to come in this morning for breakfast. Yeas I know, I should have ordered the banana etc, but the crab cake Benedict looked good, I ordered one, my wife decided to try the lobster Benedict. She rang it up and with two coffees it was 39.75.
Huh? After waiting for about 15 minutes these were going to be some dishes......NOT, the crab was not fresh, and the minuscule amount of lobster was pathetic. I don't mind paying the price but at least have more than two tablespoons of chopped lobster. The only thing that was very good was the coffee, it was great, the breakfast was so so, I wouldn't return, at least not for the egg dishes, oh and the poached eggs which you are suppose to cut and have the yolks run a little were hard boiled.
Not good!

The former Spanish Garden Inn at has reopened as Palihouse Hotel, Café and Bar. The café is quietly open to the public from 8am to 3pm daily. There's a nice garden patio in the interior courtyard with a gurgling fountain. A calm, secret retreat in the center of downtown. 

Website:
https://www.palisociety.com/hotels/santa-barbara/ 

Menu: https://s3.amazonaws.com/palisociety.com/live-v2/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/12174159/all_day_menu.pdf

Somewhat disappointing experience, though the macaroons were very tasty.  I was expecting a display case full of a variety french pastries.  What I saw was a small-ish case with a meager supply of macaroons, some croissants, some one off pastries, and cookies.  Kind of sad looking.  That being said, the macaroons were wonderful with a nice amount of filling that was not too sweet.  I would probably stop by again for macaroons now that my expectations are properly set.
Ugg.. the drive-thru is super slow. Don't come if you are in a hurry or are late to work. We came at 7pm and 2 people in line and it still took 15 mins to get our drinks.

recently in santa barbara to visit my grandfather (aww...) and got a chance to eat at the sojourner.  it's an adorable little cafe near the main drag of state st. with several vegan and veggie options on the menu.  i had the vegan mushroom pockets and they were exceptionally yummy...also, really good vegan fruit crisp with soy delicious for dessert.  anyway, if you are in SB and can get away from the country club set, the sojourner is a nice change of pace!

I went to Yoga Soup based on the several favorable Yelp reviews. The instructor I had originally hoped to take a class from was out of town so after reading all the glowing reviews about Eddie, I thought this would be a wise choice.

The décor, energy and people of Yoga Soup are warm and genuine. The Yoga Soup class I took was.....odd and unsatisfying. I do want to insert a brief disclaimer that I prefer my physical practice to have an organic flow, something challenging enough I can just lose my thoughts in because I am so intimately focused on breath and movement.

We didn't actually get onto our feet until 25 mins.  into the class, which kind of felt like a waste of time. Eddie went into numerous, and I mean NUMEROUS stories  - all of a very esoteric and nonsensical nature. Look, I totally get a narrative to start a class to draw a theme or focus for a deeper connection to the practice but after 10+ stories, I just found myself more irritated than inspired in any way. 

I do want to admit that I teach as well, so as an instructor I might be slightly more observant than others when it comes to sequencing. We only flowed through a handful of postures and my pet peeve is when an instructor forgets a very integral pose. The kind that when they forget my body literally feels crooked. If you can't remember your sequence of 10 poses - maybe less stories.

I also prefer to have a balanced practice. Standing poses, twists, backbends, hip openers and maybe an inversion if possible. In a 90 min. class I got the first two. While I respectably offer that Eddie's style may appeal to a certain type of student, I know that is not me. I used to think that all yoga is good yoga, and it is very, very rare that I leave a class feeling worse than when I stepped onto my mat.....I guess there is a first time for everything.

I was raving to my friends about what a great place i thought this was after the first time I shopped there, "a mini Whole Foods." Then I shopped there twice, ate some ready made chicken and was up all night regretting. Never again. No thanks. Vons, here I come!

Very good, natural, clean food. We only had lunch, but the staff was great. Slightly on the pricey side, but good sized salads, I only had a 1/2, but more than satisfied. We're here visiting for 5 days, and will consider for a second meal.  Looks like the menu is a good one. We sat outside because of COVID, but inside looks fine too.

In Santa Barbara for the day so I trusted yelp to choose my brunch spot. This place was good-- but not great. I ordered breakfast (classic breakfast) and my husband ordered a chicken panini. We also had coffee and a latte. Sunday around noon meant a little bit of a wait but it wasn't too bad. Food was a solid 3. Probably won't come back here again because the food isn't memorable. Cute place though!

Great new coffee roasting joint in SB.  Really great espresso drinks, and pastries from Renaud's.  The lady behind the counter was extremely rude and I almost felt bothersome just for ordering from her, but the other guy was super friendly.  In general, a great place!

We waited for someone to take our order for
20 minutes, then we waited for another 50 for our food to come. Mind you, it was not busy. We ordered eggs and a plain waffle. When it FINALLY came, the waffle was so hard that I couldn't cut into it and the eggs were pretty average. If I wait for 50 mins I expect 10/10 food. ALSO? The waffle and eggs were $12!!! Incredibly overpriced. I never leave yelp reviews, but this experience was not good. I do not blame our wait staff because I believe they were doing their best with what they had to work with. The waiter we had was the only one taking orders.

Save your money and time. DO NOT COME HERE! The location at downtown was very disappointing and misleading. Food was good service was a disaster. They charge us full price for champagnes. (FYI champagne are  buy one get second one for 5 dollars). No one told us that. Spoke with the manager or waiter about it and he just had tons of excuses no solution. 
No refund for over charging us, no complementary drink. Nothing!!! Talk about bad service and stealing customers money. 
My husband and I spend $60 on breakfast and my brother spend $40. This is no way to treat customers. Sad part is that I recommended this place. What a waste of time and money!!!. 

This location is a shame. I had such a great time in montecito that decided to visit the Dowtown location. Big mistake. Huge mistake. So many other places we could have gone. Waste of time and money. Waste of a beautiful Sunday morning. 

Not coming back. Don't think they care but I do.
Great place to chill outside on a sunny day and meet a friend. Minimal vagrants. Coffee is ok, but you knew that.
Food was delicious oj was fresh view is amazing good music and pet friendly:) service was pretty great as well

Absolutely love this studio, and have tried most of the studios in SB. The feel of the studio is warm and inviting, and it just exudes an amazing energy. I take Eddie's class any time I'm in the area, and it leaves me feeling happy. This class is yoga in it's most powerful form - a class built to release the ego and discover your authentic self. It's beautiful!!
Santa Barbara has a wonderful and  diverse coffee culture.  Good Cup is one of the best - great service and excellent state street location

Honestly they were out of everything we tried to order except for a white chocolate mocha... this is a busy location, but it's right by my house.  The guys working here are super awesome and were as accommodating as possible... in the end I just feel bad that they weren't set up for a busy Sunday by upper management.

Nevermind... I wrote this post as I was eating my second spinach feta wrap.  The first one was cold in the center so I sent it back. The second one came back the same way.  The first couple of bites are scorching, then by the time I get to the middle, it's freezing.   The heating methods they are using here are horrible.
Beautiful place, delicious Turkish deserts and excellent costumer service!!! Great place to visit in Santa Barbara
Love the food,wish the hours of operation weren't so erratic

I planned a weekend trip to Santa Barbara for my wife's birthday and found "Enjoy Cupcakes" makes cakes as well. I found a beautiful vintage rose cake from their website and sent an order via email.  Amber responded to my email quickly and we hashed out the details of my order.  I picked up my order the day of my wife's birthday (Saturday) and I got some major hubby points when she saw it.  And got additional points when we ate it. It was so good.  Thanks Amber for the beautiful cake!  We loved it!!!

OK super limited review that Tinna H. got me to do by asking about the cupcakes (I had earlier eaten at the cafe next door that bears the same "Crush" name).

Anyhow, I chose the Crush Carrot cupcake which ended up being the Saturday special flavor.  Wow it was fantastic.  Now I'm not cupcake aficionado but i can say that the carrot cake-iness was amazing.  Nice and flaky and the frosting was so sweet and smooth.

Definitely my favorite carrot cake cupcake although it's also my first.  A nice local spot that seemed pretty friendly and chill.

Cannot say enough about this amazing find. My husband and I went two mornings in a row as we couldn't find a better breakfast spot in SB durning our stay, and it was not for lack of trying. Highly recommend.

It's a nice place to have brunch on Saturdays. They have a rather sparse menu, but I had an omelet, which was decent enough. It didn't seem like it would be too filling, but it did the job. The service was pretty good; they always seemed to be refilling my coffee, which I liked. 

The best part of my experience there was that the bathrooms were really clean. Maybe it was because it was the morning and it hadn't been used too much yet... Whatever it was, my first time at Joe's was a pleasant enough experience. If ever I'm in SB again, I wouldn't mind going there.

I still long for the Soj and I moved away several years ago. The atmosphere is casual and comfortable and food delish. While  in grad school I ate here several times a week. 

The dish I miss the most is the cornbead with cheddar, beans, veggies and salsa. Not the healthiest dish in the world, but the flavors meld together so well!

I also miss the fruity turnovers with soy ice cream. Yummers!

Interior is fresh and tastefully decorated. 
Food items were perfect and beverages exactly what we ordered. Service very good, highly recommend. Tried the oatmeal, earl grey tea, americano, omelette. Ate here twice as it was that good!
It's nice to have a lunch place in Santa Barbara with quality ingredients! So many places pretend to have 'natural', 'fresh' food, but this is the real deal. Amazing coffee too.

Classic diner breakfast that did not disappoint. Perfectly cooked poached eggs on good wheat bread with crispy bacon did the trick on a New Year's day morning. Strong fresh coffee fueled the day. Friendly waitress Nicole was welcoming and efficient.

I go here every single day in one capacity or another.  I work just across the parking lot from them, so they are my absolute first line of defense against hunger, whether it be breakfast, lunch or snack.

Going on a spontaneous trip to Santa Barbara didn't exactly allow me to plan out my foodie destinations like I normally do.  As always, Yelp to the rescue.  After arriving to SB from San Jose at 3am and waking up at 7am (damn kids!) all I wanted to do was eat breakfast and hopefully get a cup of coffee to wake me up.  I looked up a few spots and with 4.5 stars, The Shop Café stood out.  We decided to check it out.

Now, after getting there, we realized it wasn't a sit down and order type place.  Instead, it was an order and then sit down kind of restaurant.  We waited in a line about 10-deep.  It went pretty fast though.  After ordering, we got our number, got some condiments and utensils, and found a table.  As for the seating area, it's all outside.  There's about 10-12 tables, but 1 communal table.

Within a few minutes, our food came out.  As usual, we tried to order all different things, so we can try out different items.  For today, we got the YOLO (buttermilk biscuit and chicken topped with gravy and then we added a poached egg), the Ahnold (Egg white scramble with kale, onions, and squash), Sweet Cakes (Pancakes) and the Best Damn Oatmeal.  Believe it or not, the item that stood out as exceptional was the Best Damn Oatmeal.  With golden raisins, honey, pecans and brown sugar, it was......well, the best damn oatmeal!  The rest of the order was good.  However, it seemed to be lacking in salt.  Which is fine by me, because I can put it on according to how I want it.  I also ordered a side of bacon and potatoes to share.  Bacon, while not many pieces in the order, was delicious, but again, the potatoes needed a little more salt.

The staff was helpful in helping me decide on what to order.  The cleaning ladies were very friendly.  Although, I believe you are supposed to buss your own tables, which we did and saw other people doing.  Laslty, I believe most, if not all, of their ingredients are organic and locally grown.  I saw a truck pull up while we were eating and it was from a vendor that provided some of those ingredients.

My wife and I hosted our rehearsal dinner with Patrick at State & Fig and he was an absolute pleasure to work with! As SB locals we've eaten here many times and always enjoyed the food and service. Our private event was no different and all our guests raved about the food. Through multiple delays and schedule changes due to COVID, Patrick was always accommodating and helped us put together a special evening that we will always remember. At the event, all his staff were friendly and on top of everything. Thank you Patrick and the whole State & Fig team!
Ordered clam chowder, French dip and Spicy Dip to go - COVID. Had a great meal!  And the staff was so warm and pleasant. We will be back!
Absolutely splendid! Very good dim sum. We were happy to find this place during our stay in Santa Barbara

Worst experience ever. Went in high hopes because such heard such amazing reviews about new chicken sandwiches. Ordered 3 chicken sandwiches, waited 20 minutes to be brought out chicken tenders on bread. No sauce and when asked for new dressings that came with was brought caesar dressing. Drink machine was not working, and offered no resolution. Spent $40 on dinner and was not offered any kind of refund or apology. Would not recommend.

Just WONDERFUL.  One would have no idea this is actually a gluten-free bakery, yet being someone who has Celiac Disease, it's something I cherish dearly.  I was there the opening week and sipped deliciously roasted coffee and sampled several of the pastries and they made me cry.  I am not kidding-- I actually wept -- it was that good.  

The owner was kind enough to come to my table and though I was a bit afraid she was going to think I was crazy, I explained that it had just been so long since I could have the simple joyous experience of sharing this with friends.  She completely understood and was such a genuinely sweet and lovely person.  It's wonderful to be able to support such a special person creating something so incredible.  

Needless to say, Lilac is the go-to not just for me, but for my friends, for all occasions and for that wonderful everyday lift to brighten the day.

AWESOME

I had the Challah French Toast, and my mom had the Italian Scramble (the Thursday Special) and we both LOVED it.

It looks like it is family owned and they make a quality product there! I highly recommend to everyone.

The workers, most of the cashiers and managers of the store are very unfriendly and some of them are rude. How's that possible that upper class store, where all the items costs higher then usual so unfriendly staff except few people.  
Also the only store where you need to take cart back to the store as there is no cart parking spots. That is ridiculous. All older gen people have to drag carts back to to the entrance.

Crushcakes is our favorite bakery! We were worried we would not be able to have their amazing cupcakes for our wedding, but thankfully we were able to make an order and have it flown up for our bid day. The cupcakes and cake tasted great, as always. The naked cake we ordered looked elegant and beautiful! The prices are very reasonable and all of their products taste so rich and delicious! The staff was helpful in our planning and purchase process, it was very appreciated.

A great stop on State to grab coffee and take a rest! I love how the place is very casual, the servers are very friendly, and it seems like an overall happy and fun place to be.  

I ordered a pourover and a spiced apple cider and both of them were extremely delicious. the pourover was done well and I loved their apple cider. It was clearer than most ciders, but the addition of lemon made the flavor very bright ! 

They have both a front patio where you can watch shoppers and cars pass by, and they also have a back patio for more conversations and quiet white noise. Hopefully I can come back soon !

Fantastic salad! I forget the name but it had brown rice, feta, roasted cashews and a delicious dressing. I added grilled chicken. All this with a cappuccino a cookie was under $15! 
The server was super friendly and speedy too!

I just special ordered Mexican wedding cookies as gifts, They were delicious! The staff is friendly the owner, Rosa was there when I picked up my order, she is so sweet, kind and welcoming, her staff is as well.
I will be back to try the chili rellenos, tamales, burritos and more of the pastries, especially Tres leches cake!

ever felt loved or cared for?? drink an espresso-based drink here and experience that again. handlebar ranks highly on my list of favorite coffee shops for its really balanced, deep, artful espresso. tysm yall

I'm a really big fan of the Old Town Salad and Gobbler Burger. Both delicious items from the restaurant... just BE CAREFUL & double check when you order something TO GO because they are not always on top of getting the whole order correct. I've had TWO instances (in the past few months) where I've been really excited to eat my favorite salad with the best dressing ever (Tahini) and so I ordered the Old Town Salad To Go (because I work downtown and only have a quick 30 minutes to pick up my food) and came back to work only to find out that I have a box with chicken on the side, and a box with my salad (with rice, carrots, feta cheese, tomatoes, etc) but NO DRESSING which is just really disappointing because I swear I order the salad mainly for their delicious dressing and I can't even go back to get the dressing because of my time crunch. And now the salad tastes super dry and I'm not sure if I'll be back to this specific location because I'm not happy with them forgetting to put dressing on my to go salad multiple times...

On a positive note, I love that they put the chicken in a separate box so that it doesn't make my salad soggy. In addition to this, I don't think that some of the employees have enough training here..  An example of why I think they may need more training is because every time I order something on the phone (more often than not), I tell them that I would like no onions and they usually always tell me that "they aren't sure if there are onions and that they'll just write that in the order notes"... In my eyes, I feel like they should know what each menu item contains rather than just guessing and writing it in the notes.  Anyway, food is good, service isn't bad, just make sure you double check any to go orders before you leave their location.

This place is perfect! Prices great! Food phenomenal!   

Spicy chicken avocado and fries! Definitely a must when in Santa Bárbara.

On a order To GO I got a breakfast burrito (with eggwhites and ham).  I understand the $1 charge for the eggwhites.  Nothing other then refried (yes, refried beans) potato and cheese were included, so I was charged for the ham and then the BILL was...  

Total for JUST a breakfast burrito = $17 !!!!!!
jesus christ!

So sad to see the young lady refuse to serve a Brown-skinned male customer outside at the door, who was requesting a drink. She told him the price but said she couldn't accept the $100 bill, all the man had. 
After pleading, a more mature superior came to the door, took the man's money and served him the drink.

I found this place in Santa Barbara when looking for a lunch takeout place that was actually open (it seems that many restaurants close between 2-5 pm in downtown SB). 
For lunch I ordered the Klassic Kyle burger. At this time you call in an order or do it online, then drive up to the restaurant, park on the street, and they bring your order out to your car. 
The great: the taste was superb, even though it's not a huge burger. 
The lows: they didn't cut the burger after I asked them to, and the host brought it out w/out napkins, and left before I realized it.

Never Again!! Went in there to get some coffee...The person who took my order was high on something(not coffee, that's for sure). After I paid for it, I waited near by to hear a shout out.. The girl behind the counter, yells, "Medium Cappuccino". I hesitated on approaching her, being that I order a Large Cappuccino, I didn't want to take someone else's drink. So she yells out again, Medium Cappuccino and looks right at me. I go up to her and explain that I had just paid for a large one. Instead of her apologizing, she looks at me with this face, and says: "Well, do you want me to make you a large one?" Unbelievable!! Duh! I only paid for it, you moron. After her attitude, I just wanted my money back!

Diego bowl was SO good! Huge portion, we said we would split one next time.

Often times bowls fall short on the toppings to acai ratio, but there was plenty to go around. Can say nothing negative, perfect start to the day!

Lunch was wonderful! 
We had fish tacos, burgers, salads, cookies... And all of it was great! There was something for everyone.
Look forward to going often, and working my way through the menu. Delicious.  Mac n Cheese (gorgonzola, pecans, bacon, apples) was great.  Nice people, nice vibe.  Thanks for opening!

Okay the LADIES at this Starbucks are 100% doing the most at all times. Especially appreciate this as I wasn't having the best day when I came in for a coffee.
Props to the employees for being as positive as they are in this busy ass location.
This is a cool little bookstore but it is going out of business on May 3rd. Everything in the store is currently 40% off.

Two Words: Warm Pastries

I love going here early in the morning to taste some of their fresh warm pastries.  My favorite is the chocolate croissant. I have tasted the almond croissant before, but I am a chocolate connoisseur(two points for the alliteration). The croissants are light on the inside, and crispy on the outside.  It is near perfection! 

I am not a big fan of their coffee, it tastes somewhat burnt. But, I come here for pastries not for their coffee ;)

Since you have so many choices, you can ask for a bite sized samples.

This place is super cute, there's two sections, one to order and one area to sit. I like that there was a window by the bar seating so you can watch them make the bowls. I went with the berry bowl and it was reallyyyyy good. Very refreshing for the morning time. The small bowl was plenty, don't think I could eat a large by myself. Price was comparable to other locations with a similar selection of bowls, about $7 for a small bowl, $9 for a large. They also have smoothies which a lot of people seemed to get and oatmeal which looked good if you're looking for a hot breakfast or snack.

The food was good, at a good price.  The staff are very friendly.  However, this was not the place for us.  It wasn't clear from yelp or the website that this is just a tiny little place with only 3 tables.  We were with our 3 year old and 18 month old and there were no high chairs... so the kids had to sit on our laps and we were barely able to eat our food.   It took a really long time to get our food, and I was confused about the order in which the food was coming out... a few people who were behind us actually got their food first.  
Also, apparently the tables are also considered community tables because some lady with no personal boundaries came and sat at our four top right next to my husband and talked to us the entire meal lol.   I would've given this place four stars, but I really think it should be made much more clear in the website to not take kids here.   If you're not going to have high chairs, you have to advertise that, because as a parent it is a total nightmare to be surprised by something like that.  
I guess I was just disappointed because it was not at all what I expected based off of what I saw on yelp when I picked the place out. Also, I have no idea why yelp says this place is "good for groups."   The place could probably seat 12 people TOTAL (not a group of 12) if you're lucky.   Yelp seriously needs to revise its specifications for this restaurant.
This is a great spot for a casual bite. High quality food made quickly, at an affordable price, with a superb finished look in a clean, fun atmosphere.

This place is solid! What an amazing breakfast joint. Had the fried chicken Benedict which was perfect, with a nicely crisp fried chicken cutlet. Fried potatoes were good, could have used more seasoning and crisper. Had an amazing latte with Handlebar coffee. Fantastic and a must!

Been coming here since they opened and consistently been great.
1. Good vibe.
2. Fabulous quality food and just enough choice...and some menu items change seasonally.  
3.  Drinks: Good oat milk & refreshing changing specials like try their new organic peach soda for a refreshing drink or and if you want a cappuccino ..know to ask for it wet or dry depending on how you like it...
4. Shout out to Kyle the manager who always remembers our name, is so dialed up and has a great smile.  Shout outs to Caspian, Victoria, Sierra, Nicole, Alana, Dafne & Noah and the team there that are always friendly and kind.  Even when the line is long, it moves fast and the staff don't seem stressed nor do they rush you...yet the line and service moves along nicely.  
We go so often that we have gotten to know the staff who are professional warm and helpful.  I have never been to a morning place until now, that consistently has kind, awake and happy staff. Thank you
5. Location...fabulous...and then enjoy a walk along the beach or in the Funk zone after your meal.
6. Local organics...my understanding is they support local organic farmers and thus you are eating healthy thanks to that..and supporting the local community and leaving a smaller footprint. :)  Thank you Helena Bakery.  Thank you Acme Hospitality!

Went to breakfast a few times with a friend and got the salmon eggs benedict. Mind blowing good. Thick slices of salmon on top of eggs and french toast. The service lagged behind the bomb food though, hence the four and not five stars. 

Oh and the egg rose, overrated. The olive toast wasn't anything too great. Sorry Food Network.

Such a wonderful experience!! I came here for mother daughter breakfast and will definitely return again. The staff was very attentive and professional. We had the breakfast sandwich and the mushroom toast, both were delicious with generous portions and reasonable prices. The almond croissant was truthfully the best I've ever had. Their coffee is a must try too. This is a great stop for either breakfast, lunch or to grab a delicious pastry and coffee to go.

I stopped in yesterday for the first time and bought a sampling of treats: a chocolate chip cookie sandwich filled with salted brown butter frosting, a six pack of their mini cupcakes, a cookie dough ball, and a peanut butter chocolate mousse cup. All were good,  but we really loved the cookie sandwich and the snicker doodle and salted butterscotch cupcakes. The man at the counter said "see you tomorrow" - and if I didn't live in San Francisco, he probably would have.

This place is perfect. Order at the window they bring it out. Really good price for the area, had the Tug Boat w Fried chicken and it blew my mind. Not only do they have bomb food but they have bomb coffee. My wife's latte was fire exactly the same as you would get at Handlebar Coffee downtown. 

I'm gonna stop here every time I'm in Santa Barbara.

This place knows their coffee and tea.  Aside from the expertly made espresso drinks, they also have a great selection of loose leaf teas personally selected by the owner Chris who is always more than willing to drop some expert knowledge if you ask the right questions.  I really enjoy the way they serve tea in a removable strainer that fits into a mug.  You can go back up to the counter as much as you want and ask for more hot water to re steep the leaves which is a huge plus for loose leaf tea fans.

The ambiance is pleasant while being both simple and mildly industrial at the same time.  Most of their cakes, cookies and pastries are baked fresh in the morning, and the bagels are some of the best you can get in SB (I think they're from bagel cafe).  They also have pretty cool artwork hanging on the walls to give you something unique to look at when zoning out or just wandering around.

I highly recommend this place for relaxing and reading, enjoying some Coffee and snacks with friends, or bringing in your laptop to get some work done while sipping on some tea (they have a decent amount of outlets unlike The French Press which has none!).  Definitely my go to coffee shop in Santa Barbara.

La Bella Rosa Bakery cakes are amazing. Michelle can make any design come true, no matter how wacky! She is incredibly patient! The cakes are moist and delicious. I ordered one for our Dad's birthday and one for his Celebration of Life. So thankful they will deliver tomorrow. Very reasonably priced!
Love it, best location, sit on the beach with feet in the sand.  Beer is good, margaritas okay, always order the spicy ahi and rice bowl, great happy hour.

One of my favorite breakfast places in Santa Barbara by far! The coffee is outstanding and the all the ingredients are fresh and delicious. I always order one poached egg with a toasted croissant and a yummy cup of coffee. It's just enough food for me and its so good! Tables are a little hard to come by and sometimes you have to wait, especially during those peak hours. They also sell fresh baked goods! Mmmm!

Top choice for breakfast in Santa Barbara. Top quality ingredients creatively combined. They can get super busy so patience is advised. You customize your hash. Delicious. The co-manager, Coen, is very attentive, polite and professional. I ordered at the counter but he gave me full table service! Well worth any brief wait in line.

I throughly enjoyed this hidden gem.  The owner is mellow but affable. The food is great. It's creative, full of flavor and doesn't give you the 'food hangover' you can get from comfort food. 

For vegetarians or vegans, it's especially good, with many choices. The staff is welcoming to substitutions and more importantly they offer suggestions. 

The only criticism I have is that sometimes they run out of a particular item / ingredient for a dish. However they have suggestions for substitutions and are gracious.
